modules_cfg.lead: Turn off the areas your clinic doesn't use. They disappear from the menu for everyone and their pages are closed.
modules_cfg.data_kept: Turning an area off never deletes anything — its records stay and come back as they were when you turn it on again.

m.finance: Expenses, budgets, profit & loss and partners

d.online_booking: Patients book from the clinic page. Off: the booking page is closed and booking links are hidden.
d.online_consultations: Video consultations for patients abroad. Turning it off also stops new online bookings.
d.billing: Cashier queue, invoices, receipts, card payments and refunds.
d.staff_salaries: Monthly salaries for nurses, reception and other staff.
d.finance: Clinic expenses, monthly budgets, profit & loss and partner shares.
d.supplies: Stock of consumables, low-stock alerts and purchase orders.
d.marketplace: Products and offers from medical reps and warehouses, and rep visit bookings.
d.certificates: Sick leave, medical reports and attendance certificates.
d.reviews: Verified reviews from patients after their visit.
d.specialty_records: Dental chart, child growth and pregnancy follow-up.
d.ai_assistant: Visit summaries, second opinion and prescription checks.
d.attendance: Clock-in and clock-out for the team.
d.queue_screens: A TV in the waiting room showing who goes in now, the room number and who is next, with a chime.
d.staff_chat: Messages, pictures and files between the team inside the clinic.
d.patient_sharing: Send the prescription, requests and invoice by secure link on WhatsApp or e-mail, plus the thank-you and review request.
d.centres: Send prescriptions and lab / imaging requests to pharmacies and centres, and lists for centres inside the clinic.
d.staff_mail: Each member connects their own e-mail to read and send from their address with the clinic's papers. Automatic messages stay on the clinic address.
d.surgeries: Book the doctor's time for operations — patient, procedure, hospital — and send the date to the hospital by e-mail or WhatsApp.

modules_cfg.core_sub: The core of the clinic can't be turned off.
modules_cfg.off_text: “{name}” is turned off for this clinic. Its records are kept and come back when it is turned on again.
modules_cfg.off_plan_text: “{name}” is not included in the clinic's current plan.
modules_cfg.off_ask: Ask the clinic manager if you need it.

invoice_tpl.lead: How printed invoices and receipts look: paper size, what is printed and the invoice numbers. This letterhead (logo and its size, clinic name, address and phone) applies to every paper: invoices, prescriptions, reports, certificates, test requests and referrals, printed or sent to the patient.
invoice_tpl.billing_off: Cashier and billing are turned off for this clinic. The template is kept for when you turn them on.
invoice_tpl.paper_sub: Choose what your printer uses. The 80 mm receipt uses a narrow layout for receipt printers.
invoice_tpl.fields_sub: Turn off what you don't want on the printed copy. The screen always shows everything.
invoice_tpl.stamp_help: Printed only when the stamp is uploaded and enabled for invoices in
invoice_tpl.qr_note: A verification QR code will be added here once invoices can be verified online.
invoice_tpl.numbers_sub: A prefix shown before the number, and the number the next invoice gets.
invoice_tpl.prefix_help: Letters, digits and - / _ . only (up to 12). Example: INV-
invoice_tpl.next_help: Currently {n}. It can only be raised, never lowered.
invoice_tpl.none_issued: No invoice has been issued yet.
invoice_tpl.tax_help: Printed on invoices when “Tax number” is on.
invoice_tpl.footer_sub: A short line at the bottom of the invoice. Leave empty for the default thank-you note.
invoice_tpl.lh_sub: Where the logo and the clinic name go, and the logo size.
invoice_tpl.lh_help: The invoice number and date take the other side. When the logo and the name share a place, the name sits under the logo. On the 80 mm receipt everything is centred.

svc_cat.title: Main services
svc_cat.sub: Each main service groups its sub-services on this page, the clinic website and the booking page.
svc_cat.none_yet: Add main services in the "Main services" panel to group sub-services under them.
svc_cat.empty: No main services yet. Services are listed together until you add some.
svc_cat.deleted: Main service deleted; its sub-services stay.
svc_cat.delete_confirm: Delete this main service? Its sub-services stay, without a main service.
svc_cat.show_on_site: Shown on the clinic website and booking page (with its sub-services)

demo.title: Sample data
demo.sub_none: Try {brand} with a few sample records before entering your own.
demo.sub_has: This clinic has sample records. Remove them before you start working for real.
demo.what_patients: 3 patients with made-up names and 07900000xx numbers
demo.labelled: Every sample record is marked “(demo)” or “(تجريبي)” and can be removed in one step without touching your own data.
demo.added: Sample data added: {doctors} doctors, {patients} patients and {appointments} appointments.
demo.remove_help: Deletes exactly the sample records and what was added to them (visit notes, prescriptions, invoices, payments). Your own records are never touched.
demo.remove_confirm: All sample records and everything added to them will be deleted. Type “{word}” to confirm.
demo.confirm_mismatch: Type “{word}” to confirm removing the sample data.
demo.removed_kept: Sample data removed ({n} records). {kept} sample records were kept because your own records use them.

updater.title: System update
updater.lead: Update {brand} from the update file directly — no server access needed.
updater.source_title: Updates are available in the installed build only
updater.source_text: This copy runs from source code. Update it from the code repository.
updater.upload_sub: The update file (.zip), up to {mb} MB.
updater.file_help: Checked before anything is written: only {brand}'s own files, no node_modules, no .env, no paths outside the app.
updater.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check the connection and try again.
updater.needs_js: Uploading needs JavaScript to be enabled in the browser.
updater.staged: Version {v} was uploaded and checked. Review it and activate when ready.
updater.older_warning: The uploaded version is older than the current one.
updater.same_warning: The uploaded version is the same as the current one.
updater.before_backup: The current files are backed up first; you can roll back from this page.
updater.before_restart: {brand} restarts: people using it will be interrupted for a few seconds.
updater.before_db: Database changes of the new version run on the next start and stay after a rollback.
updater.before_env: Your .env settings and uploaded data are not changed.
updater.activate_confirm: Replace the current version with {v} and restart {brand}? Type the version to confirm.
updater.confirm_mismatch: Type the version number to confirm.
updater.backups_sub: The last three versions you can go back to.
updater.rollback_confirm: Restore version {v} from the latest backup and restart {brand}?
updater.how_2: Upload it here; it is checked and kept aside until you activate it.
updater.how_3: Activate: the current files are backed up, the new ones copied and {brand} restarts.
updater.how_4: If the host doesn't restart it on its own, restart the app from the hosting panel.
updater.activated_text: Version {to} replaced {from}. The new version starts in a few seconds.
updater.rolled_back_text: Version {to} was restored (it replaced {from}). It starts in a few seconds.
updater.restart_manual: Still waiting after a minute? Restart the app from the hosting panel (Setup Node.js App → Restart) or with your process manager.
updater.restart_note: The system restarts within seconds and the database is updated automatically. Refresh the page shortly.
updater.install_sub: Upload the update file (.zip) as you received it.
updater.package_help: Up to {mb} MB. A zip with its files inside one folder is accepted too.
updater.step_backup: A backup of the current version is saved before anything changes.
updater.step_keep: The settings file (.env) and clinic data are never touched.
updater.step_migrate: The database is updated automatically on restart.
updater.restore_sub: The current version is backed up first, then the system restarts.
updater.db_auto: Applied by themselves on start, every 5 minutes while running, and whenever a page needs a new table — no command needed.
updater.db_uptodate: The database is up to date.
updater.from_source_title: This installation runs from its source code
updater.from_source_text: You can update it here with the ready update file: your current files are backed up first, then the site runs the new ready build (no npm install needed).
